turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How do I tell if online reviews are fake? This bluetooth speaker has like five thousand stars and I don't believe it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Healthy suspicion. Look at the bad reviews first, they're often more honest about what actually breaks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There are almost no bad ones.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a warning sign by itself. Also watch for lots of short, vague reviews posted around the same few days.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, loads of them say great product, fast shipping. That's it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Exactly the pattern. Reviews with photos, details and some complaints alongside the praise are usually the real ones.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I'd look up the speaker on a proper review site, or pick a brand you recognise. Paying a little more for something reliable often saves money.
